collect.title: What we collect
collect.body: Name, email address, profile photo (from Google if you use Google sign-in), classroom memberships, messages you send, and verification documents (auto-deleted after 30 days).

use.title: How we use it
use.body: To connect you with your alumni network and verify your membership in classrooms. We never use your data for advertising.

never.title: What we never do
never.body: We never sell your personal data. We never show ads. We never share your data with third parties except to operate the service (Supabase for database, Google for sign-in).

protect.title: How we protect it
protect.body: All data is encrypted in transit and at rest. Row-level security means you only see data you are permitted to see. Verification documents are automatically deleted after 30 days.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.body: You can request a copy of your data, correct it, or delete your account at any time. Email hello@alumtribe.com.

what.title: What AlumTribe is
what.body: A private verified network for school and college alumni.

who.title: Who can use it
who.body: You must be a genuine alumni, student, or teacher of the institution you are joining. Fake accounts or joining classrooms you were not part of is not allowed.

verification.title: Verification
verification.body: We require verification before you can post. Providing false verification documents is grounds for permanent removal.

conduct.title: Conduct
conduct.body: No spam, harassment, hate speech, or illegal content. Keep conversations respectful. Admins can remove content and suspend accounts that violate these rules.

ourRights.title: Our rights
ourRights.body: We can remove content or suspend accounts that violate these terms. We will always try to notify you first.

liability.title: Limitation of liability
liability.body: AlumTribe is provided as-is. We are not liable for content posted by users.
